plugins.name: ai-council
plugins.description: Use when a plan or creative decision would benefit from several AI models working independently — running one brief through multiple assistants (e.g. ChatGPT, Grok, Gemini, an on-device model) and merging the results.

plugins.name: app-store-answer-check
plugins.description: Use before submitting a mobile app to the Apple App Store, Google Play or Samsung Galaxy Store — to verify privacy labels, data safety, age rating answers and listing claims against what the code actually does.

plugins.name: apple-on-device-llm
plugins.description: Use when you want to run Apple's free on-device language model (Foundation Models framework, Apple Intelligence Macs) from the command line for short private text tasks such as hooks, captions or summaries.

plugins.name: free-video-tools-check
plugins.description: Use when choosing free tools for making and scheduling short videos — checking what free tiers of AI video, voice, editing and scheduling tools really allow (credits, watermarks, commercial use) before relying on them.

plugins.name: launch-reveal-series
plugins.description: Use when planning a "Day N of showing you what we built" social video series to launch an app or product — counting features, structuring days, hooks, cliffhangers, per-platform posting and scheduling.

plugins.name: parallel-agent-queue
plugins.description: Use when coordinating several AI coding/research agents (Codex, Claude Code, Grok, Gemini CLIs or API runs) on one machine — keeping them busy from a job queue with safe limits, status files and usage planning.

plugins.name: reel-editor
plugins.description: Use when turning long raw footage (B-roll, archive or public-domain video, your own clips) into a short vertical reel or short, or when reviewing one — picking the moments, where to cut, assembling montages, rhythm, sound, captions, originality and credit.

plugins.name: secure-mcp-keys
plugins.description: Use when connecting a local MCP server that needs an access token (e.g. a desktop app's automation server) to Claude Code, Codex or other agents — keeping the token in the macOS Keychain instead of chat, files or shell history.

plugins.name: social-account-audit
plugins.description: Use when asked to review Instagram, Facebook, TikTok or similar account insights and turn them into a posting plan — audiences, active times, reach sources, follower trends and what content performs.

plugins.name: storage-cleanup-github-first
plugins.description: Use when a computer is low on disk space from development work — finding large project folders, making sure anything worth keeping is backed up to GitHub (or cloud storage) first, then removing what will never be used again.
